objectives.description: Create test-orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh using test-orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh's sandbox model with real (unstubbed) collaborators, including a real git repo for commit testing
Acceptance (1): stale mtime routes to recovery
Acceptance (2): dispatch_seq mismatch routes to recovery even with newer mtime
Acceptance (4): both directions of writer-contract-aware recording
Invariants: 9999999999 sentinel shared, excursion advisory never a gate, --dry-run mutates nothing
Suite naming discipline (candidate #N, never task N)

approaches_tried.description: Initial test assertions checked stderr text directly for D2's DISPATCH_SEQ MISMATCH notice, and used jq -r with an inline escaped-comma join() for the user_decision options array
approaches_tried.reason: orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh discards orchestrate-recover-outcome.sh's stderr by design (2>/dev/null, matching orchestrate-stage5-gates.sh's own established precedent), so the notice is never observable from the caller's own stderr -- fixed by probing orchestrate-recover-outcome.sh directly with the same arguments. The join() quoting inside a nested jqf() call did not survive shell interpolation cleanly -- fixed by comparing the whole user_decision object via jq -c round-tripping instead of picking fields.

real_bugs_found_during_this_phase: git-commit-scoped.sh's own commit-summary echo was leaking onto orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh's stdout (uncontained by any redirect at the call site), corrupting the single-JSON-line stdout contract every caller of this script depends on. Same issue independently discovered for skill_postflight_update (-> update-task-status.sh's own 'OK: task N status -> ...' echo) and skill_link_artifacts (-> generate-todo.sh's own stdout). Fixed by redirecting each of these four call sites' stdout to stderr (>&2) -- none of them needed to affect this script's own exit code, only their side effects and their own (now-redirected) diagnostic text.
